meta.title: Lots cannot be published during the submission window
gaps: Open Settings → Split Line Items into Lots and verify the lot drawer's Publish Lot control is unavailable or disabled during the submission window.
Verify that lots can only be published during the evaluation stage.
warnings: cannot test this case yet — no step can observe: Open Settings → Split Line Items into Lots and verify the lot drawer's Publish Lot control is unavailable or disabled during the submission window.; Verify that lots can only be published during the evaluation stage.

steps.note: Create the RFQ needed for the submission-window state.
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction.
Apply an RFQ template before adding line items.
Add a line item required for publishing the RFQ.
Keep the event in its active submission window after publishing.
Add the participant required to publish a usable RFQ.
Publish the RFQ so it is in the submission window.
Confirm the RFQ reached its published project page.
Open the published event's Settings menu, the closest catalog entry point for the requested lot action.
Check whether the requested lot-splitting entry is offered; this does not inspect Publish Lot itself.
